input.rationale: The only grant running in our favour is the Section 1.4 access and right to use the hosting system, software and Content administration tools. It runs to "the Company" alone, and Section 10.3 confirms that "no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement", so our affiliates have no coverage and no path to be added — the fallback affiliate element fails. The successor element is already satisfied because Section 10.3 makes the Agreement enforceable by the parties' successors and assigns without consent. HDI has no express at-will revocation right, so this is not walk-away territory; termination on ninety days' notice under Section 4.1 is a renewal/termination point, not a licence-revocation point. We therefore target the fallback with a single sentence extending the Section 1.4 rights to our affiliates on written notice, phrased as an exercise of the Company's own rights so it does not collide with Section 10.3.
